summary: The ServiceCode file defines and manages service codes within the HSPnet framework. It includes methods to retrieve service codes based on course or timetable.
purpose: To manage and provide access to service codes necessary for organizing and cataloging services within the HSPnet system.

workflows.name: Retrieve Service Codes
steps: Set procedure name for database operation.
Execute database query to fetch service codes.
Localize service codes based on session language settings.

system_behavior: Service codes are localized based on session language settings.
Service codes are fetched using stored procedures.
